# Bing

> > Bing is Microsoft's search engine offering web search, shopping price comparison, image search, and integrated AI-powered experiences.

Bing provides comprehensive search capabilities with specialized features for shopping, including the Microsoft Shopping platform that aggregates product listings, compares prices across retailers, and surfaces deals from merchants like Williams Sonoma, David's Bridal, and Cartier.

## Key Topics

- Microsoft Shopping
- Bing Search
- Price Comparison
- Product Listings
- Online Shopping
- Deals and Discounts
- Trending Products
- Microsoft Merchant Center
- Retail Partners
- Shopping Aggregation

## Shopping and E-Commerce

- [Shop Online, Find Deals, and Compare Prices | Microsoft Shopping](https://www.bing.com/shop): Microsoft Shopping price comparison and deals aggregator for products
